stops.note: replaced classical feles; the farming writer Palladius recommends keeping cats among the artichokes to deal with moles; the word may come from a North African language, but its source is unknown
the word spread almost as fast as the animal, from Irish cat to Russian kot; Welsh laws of Hywel Dda in the 900s fixed the value of a good mouser
reinforced by Old French chat; 'cat' as jazz slang for a hip person dates from the 1920s

current_meaning: a small domesticated carnivorous mammal with soft fur
